seo.title: Chris Codes Launch Kit
seo.description: Chris Codes Launch Kit is a starter site for building and launching new digital projects.

content.title: Getting Started
content.text:
This is a Nuxt starter for new Chris Codes frontend projects.

  1. Start with the layout. Edit modules/layout/config.js for the grid, breakpoints, and media queries, then run yarn build:layout. See the Layout section in README.md for more detail.
  2. Add your colours, type, and space in app/assets/css/variables/ and app/assets/css/global/, then update the Style Guide.
  3. Build and style UI building blocks in the Component Library.
  4. Build the content components on the Content Components page. Add dummy content under modules/content/fixtures, then run yarn build:content. See the Content build section in README.md for more detail.

Read the README.md in the repo for the full setup, env vars, and how the stack fits together.
